insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: ₹3,00,000 / ₹4,00,000 / ₹5,00,000 / ₹10,00,000 (as per tables shown; Individual or Floater variants mentioned)

good.name: Room Rent
good.quote: A. Room (Single Standard A/C room), Boarding and Nursing Expenses
good.explanation: The policy provides a private Single Standard AC room for hospitalization. This means you get a private air-conditioned room but not unlimited room choices or at actual costs.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months from the start of coverage. You must maintain the policy for 3 years before claims for these conditions are payable.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the following listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with us.
good.explanation: Specific illnesses are excluded for 24 months from policy start. You need to wait 2 years before claiming for these specified conditions.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered during the first 30 days except for accidents. This prevents immediate claims after buying the policy.

bad.name: Restore Benefit
bad.quote: There shall be automatic restoration of the Basic Sum Insured by 100% immediately upon exhaustion of the basic sum insured, once during the policy period. It is made clear that such restored Sum Insured can be utilized only for illness /disease/treatment unrelated to the illness /diseases/treatment for which claim/s was/were made.
bad.explanation: The sum insured is restored only once per year and only for unrelated illnesses. You cannot use the restored amount for the same illness, limiting financial protection.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Associated medical expenses... do not include Cost of pharmacy and consumables, Cost of implants and medical devices and Cost of diagnostics.
bad.explanation: Consumables like gloves, syringes, implants, and diagnostics are not covered. You may have to pay these costs yourself during hospitalization.

bad.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
bad.quote: Relevant Pre Hospitalization medical expenses incurred for a period not exceeding 30 days prior to the date of Hospitalisation
bad.explanation: Pre-hospitalization expenses are covered only up to 30 days, which is the minimum acceptable period. This may limit coverage for longer diagnostic or treatment needs before admission.

bad.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
bad.quote: Post Hospitalization expenses incurred up to 60 days after discharge... shall not exceed the sum equivalent to 7% of the hospitalization expenses subject to a maximum of Rs.5,000/- per hospitalization
bad.explanation: Post-hospitalization cover is limited to 60 days and capped at 7% of hospital expenses or ₹5,000. This may be insufficient for follow-up care, leading to out-of-pocket costs.

bad.name: No Claim Bonus
bad.quote: Where the policy is issued for more than 1 year, the Basic Sum Insured including sublimits, cumulative bonus (if applicable), automatic restoration benefit (if applicable) is for each of the year
bad.explanation: The policy does not explicitly provide a no claim bonus that increases sum insured. Your coverage amount may not grow over time if you do not claim.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: The Company will pay... the amount of such expenses as are reasonably and necessarily incurred up-to the limits indicated but not exceeding sum insured in aggregate as stated in the schedule hereto;
bad.explanation: The policy wording does not clearly state if any co-payment applies. It is unclear whether you must pay a portion of claims, so check the policy schedule or detailed terms.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: Cashless facility can be availed only in networked Hospitals
unclear.explanation: Cashless claims are available only at network hospitals, but the number and location of these hospitals are not specified. This affects how easily you can access cashless treatment.

unclear.name: Proportionate Deduction
unclear.quote: If Policy Holder chooses a higher room category above the eligibility defined in policy, then proportionate deduction will apply on the Associated Medical Expenses in addition to the difference in room rent.
unclear.reference: Definitions – 'Associated medical expenses' (Page 2/10) and Special conditions note (Page 4/10)
unclear.explanation: If you opt for a room category higher than your eligibility, the insurer may reduce claim amounts proportionally. Confirm your room eligibility to avoid unexpected deductions.

unclear.name: Modern Treatments
unclear.quote: Section 4 - Coverage for Modern Treatments... is limited to the amount mentioned in table below; * Sublimit all inclusive with or without hospitalization
unclear.reference: Coverage – Section 4 and the Modern Treatment table (Page 4-5/10)
unclear.explanation: Modern treatments are covered but subject to procedure-wise sublimits that vary by sum insured and plan type. Ensure your sum insured provides adequate limits for needed treatments.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
